subject: Next steps: SOC 2 / HIPAA checklist, pen-test report access & vulnerability SLA
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@medsyn.com>, Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@medsyn.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Post-demo recap & quick security/ops questions

Hi Sam / Priya,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — appreciate you walking us through the Medsyn data flow. A couple quick items the security and procurement teams asked us to confirm so we can progress to a commercial proposal: 

- SOC 2: Do you have a current SOC 2 Type II report (date of most recent audit)?
- HIPAA: Will Medsyn require a BAA from Redwood? If yes, can you confirm scope (PHI in logs, de-id lists, etc.)?
- Pen test: Would you accept a redacted vendor pen-test summary and CVSS severity table, or do you need the full report under NDA?
- Vulnerability management: any internal SLA expectations for disclosure/remediation (e.g., 30 days for critical vs 90 for low)?
- Questionnaire: I'll send our vendor security questionnaire link — can you confirm a preferred contact to field it?

Next steps I propose: we (1) share a redacted pen-test summary + SOC 2 summary, (2) send vendor-questionnaire link for your security team to assign, (3) provide a draft BAA if required. If that works I can loop Priya to own the intake.

Thanks — Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

From: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@medsyn.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@medsyn.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2026 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & quick security/ops questions

Rishi — thanks, useful recap. A few clarifications from our security ops side: 

- SOC 2: we need a Type II report covering the last 12 months; date of last Redwood audit?
- HIPAA / BAA: yes, we will require a BAA if we route any PHI through the service. We can review your standard BAA but will push for logging controls.
- Pen test: our risk team prefers the full pen-test report (including technical findings) under NDA. If you can only provide a redacted summary publicly, will you allow our external assessor (BlueHat Security) to sign an NDA and review the full report?
- Vulnerability SLA: baseline expectation is 30 days for critical (P1), 60 for high (P2), 120 for medium/low — is that compatible?

Can Priya N. (on your team) and Marissa (security) coordinate details and share the next docs/links? Thanks — Sam

--
Sam Taylor
CISO, Medsyn Health
sam.taylor@medsyn.com

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2026 17:45:00 +0000
Subject: FW: Post-demo recap & quick security/ops questions

Marissa / Rishi — looping you both to confirm what we can share and the intake steps so we respond in one go to Medsyn. Notes from my side (internal):

- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report for period ending 2025-11-30. We can share the report and the SOC control summary PDF (redwood-soc2-summary-2025-type2.pdf).

- BAA: We have a standard BAA template. We require DocuSign signature for legal — link to be generated. We should call out log retention windows and KMS key ownership options.

- Pen test: Security policy — we provide a redacted pen-test summary publicly (high-level findings, CVSS table, remediation status) and full report under NDA to approved third parties. Proposed approach for Medsyn: have BlueHat sign our standard NDA (or sign Medsyn NDA if legal approves), then provide full report. For immediate progress, attach a redacted pen-test summary and an executive summary to the customer.

- Vulnerability SLA / cadence: our standard publicly advertised SLA for Redwood-hosted customers is: Critical (P1) — 30 days; High (P2) — 60 days; Medium/Low — 120 days. For enterprise (Dedicated/Private) we can negotiate tighter SLAs in the contract. Scanning cadence recommendations: external auth scans weekly, full external scans monthly, internal network scans quarterly, and authenticated dynamic scans prior to major releases.

- Evidence/attachments: I'll attach the redacted pen test summary and SOC2 summary. I'll also generate a vendor-questionnaire link (hosted form) and a DocuSign BAA link.

Action items (internal):
1) Rishi — confirm that Medsyn prefers Redwood NDA or Medsyn-provided NDA for BlueHat.
2) Marissa — I need final redaction approval on the pen-summary (should remove IP addresses, customer identifiers).
3) Rishi — confirm timeline for Medsyn to review (Sam asked for compat w/ 30/60/120).

Thanks — Priya

--
Priya Natarajan
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@medsyn.com>, Priya Kapoor <priya.kapoor@medsyn.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & quick security/ops questions

Hi Sam / Priya K.,

Thanks for the quick replies and for clarifying Medsyn's expectations. Per the thread above here are the agreed next steps and artifacts from Redwood: 

1) Pen-test access: Attached is a redacted pen-test summary (redwood-pen-test-summary-2026-q2.pdf) with CVSS breakdown and remediation status. We're happy to provide the full technical report to BlueHat Security after an NDA is executed. Please let us know whether Medsyn will sign Redwood's NDA or prefers to have BlueHat sign Medsyn's NDA; we can accommodate either.

2) SOC 2: Attached is Redwood's SOC 2 Type II summary (redwood-soc2-summary-2025-type2.pdf). Full report can be shared to authorized legal/security contacts.

3) BAA: If you require BAA coverage, here's the DocuSign link to our standard BAA: https://na.docusign.com/BAA-Redwood-Medsyn. The BAA covers log retention options and key management choices.

4) Vulnerability SLA & scanning cadence: Our standard enterprise commitments are: Critical (P1) — 30 days; High (P2) — 60 days; Medium/Low — 120 days. Recommended scanning cadence: weekly authenticated checks on customer-facing endpoints, monthly full external scans, quarterly internal scans, and authenticated dynamic scans pre-major-release. If Medsyn needs tighter SLAs, we can add contract language under Dedicated/Private offerings.

5) Vendor questionnaire: here's a hosted link to our vendor security questionnaire for Medsyn to assign to your security reviewer: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-security-pack (questionnaire is in the folder as vendor-questionnaire-link.txt).

Proposed next milestone: once NDA / BAA decision is confirmed, we can get BlueHat access to the full report and schedule a short walk-through with Marissa to go over technical findings. Can you confirm whether Medsyn will use Redwood NDA or provide your own by EOD Friday (30 Jul)?

Thanks — looking forward to moving this to procurement.

--
Priya Natarajan
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-pen-test-summary-2026-q2.pdf (redacted), redwood-soc2-summary-2025-type2.pdf
